name: Just Axiom It — The PR Collapse Clip
creator: Axiom Corponation Communications Dept. (source); viral spread anonymous
description: In 2207, Axiom's Chief Experience Officer Preethi Solberg-Nakamura ended a live earnings feed with 'Whatever your problem is — just Axiom it,' intended as an empowerment slogan during a quarter when Axiom had raised Shelf-tier service fees by 34%. The clip, pushed through every neural feed tier simultaneously via paid promotion, immediately became the go-to phrase for dismissing any systemic injustice with performative corporate positivity. The original clip is now looped with a half-second audio stutter on the word 'it' that no one has ever been able to attribute to a specific editor.
medium: neural feed clip, audio loop, BCI haptic remix
cultural_impact: The phrase entered everyday speech within 72 hours and has never left; it functions simultaneously as sincere corporate aspiration in Tier 4-5 contexts and as bitter sarcasm on the Shelf, making it one of the few memes that genuinely means opposite things to different classes.
controversy: Axiom filed seventeen takedown requests against haptic remix versions that added simulated pain responses to the stutter; all failed on fair-use grounds. Solberg-Nakamura quietly resigned four months later.
story_hooks: A character uses 'just Axiom it' sincerely in a Tier 4 context and is met with silent, uncomfortable stares from their Tier 2 colleagues.
Someone tracks down the original editor who added the stutter — it was an Axiom intern who has since disappeared from public records.
An underground artist builds an entire gallery installation around the clip, looping it 34 times — once for each percent of the fee increase.
